exceptions.reason: Each case of the block renders on a server with no hydration, so each case is in the Node file of the folder.

exceptions.title: handles focus and positioner height
exceptions.reason: Base UI runs its browser tests only in Chromium, and the case asserts pixel sizes of the default font of Chromium. Firefox and WebKit have other default fonts. The Vase UI case compares the size variable of the positioner with the measured size of the content, so it runs in each engine.

exceptions.title: handles positioner width correctly
exceptions.reason: Base UI runs its browser tests only in Chromium, and the case asserts pixel sizes of the default font of Chromium. Firefox and WebKit have other default fonts. The Vase UI case compares the size variable of the positioner with the measured size of the content, so it runs in each engine.

exceptions.title: does not animate popup sizing when kept nested default content first moves into the portal
exceptions.reason: The case gives the popup a shell height for the first read of `offsetHeight` and the full height for the next reads, after the click. In Vue, the popup measures its open size in the flush of the click, before the case can mock the size, and the kept nested content is in the portal at that measure. The Vase UI case measures the real layout: each fixed height of the popup is its open height.
The cases assert the `displayName` of a React context. A Vue injection key has no such name.

exceptions.title: keeps a hover-open menu open when pointerdown happens on a nested dialog trigger
exceptions.reason: The case renders `Dialog.Popup`, which Vase UI does not have.

exceptions.title: keeps the menu open when interacting with a nested dialog
exceptions.reason: The case renders `Dialog.Popup`, which Vase UI does not have.

exceptions.title: keeps the menu open when interacting with a nested popover
exceptions.reason: The case renders `Popover.Portal`, `Popover.Positioner` and `Popover.Popup`, which Vase UI does not have.
The default tag is `nav`, or `div` when the root is nested. The part decides it in `setup`, so the prop `as` has no static default.

surfaceAdditions.reason: The part reads `id` to replace an absent id with a generated id, which the active trigger names in `aria-controls`. It is thus a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the popup, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.

The part reads `id` to replace an absent id with a generated id, which the owner element of the active trigger names in `aria-owns`. It is thus a declared prop. Base UI reads it from the native attributes of the viewport, and `types.md` has no row for a native attribute.
